earliest_listing_dates: 2012-01 onward, as present in the captures
access_note: Public FDA CSV replayed through the Internet Archive; no credentials required
transforms: extract and normalize presentation NDCs to NDC9
construct monthly shortage-active intervals from initial posting and observed resolution
right-censor unresolved products at the last captured month
target_semantics: national FDA-reported shortage status by NDC9 and supplier
limitations: not Arkansas county allocation or pharmacy inventory
resolved status is not proof of local availability
products absent after archive end are not assigned zero labels
capture cadence is irregular and historical FDA listings may be revised
